hook: Brazil borders almost every country in South America. Can you name the two it doesn't?

beats.narration: Brazil borders almost every country in South America. Can you name the two it doesn't?
It has ten neighbours. Nine countries, plus French Guiana, which is part of France.
beats.claim: Brazil borders nine South American countries and French Guiana.

beats.narration: The two it never touches: Chile and Ecuador.
beats.claim: Brazil borders every South American country except Chile and Ecuador.

beats.narration: All together, its land border runs sixteen thousand eight hundred and eighty five kilometres.
Only China and Russia have longer land borders.
beats.claim: Brazil has the world's third-longest land border, behind China and Russia.

beats.narration: And here's the twist. France's longest border isn't in Europe. It's this one, with Brazil. Seven hundred and thirty kilometres.
beats.claim: The Brazil–France border is 730 km, France's longest; Spain is second at 623 km.

title: Brazil borders everyone… except these 2
description: Brazil touches every South American country except Chile and Ecuador. And its border with France is France's longest.
